name: slimad/colnect-api-laravel
description: Laravel integration for the Colnect API (CAPI): configuration, container bindings, a facade, a cache-backed rate limiter shared by every worker, Retry-After aware retries, Artisan commands and test fakes on top of slimad/colnect-api.

ignore.CVE-2026-33182: Saloon 3: an absolute URL in a request endpoint overrides the base URL. Every CAPI endpoint is a relative path built by slimad/colnect-api from validated input. Fixed in Saloon 4, which slimad/colnect-api does not support yet.
ignore.CVE-2026-33183: Saloon 3: path traversal through fixture names. Neither this package nor slimad/colnect-api uses fixtures.
ignore.CVE-2026-33942: Saloon 3: insecure deserialization in AccessTokenAuthenticator. CAPI requests are signed with HMAC; no OAuth authenticator is used.

scripts-descriptions.ci: Runs the full local quality gate: coding standards, static analysis, tests and mutation testing.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Checks the coding standards without modifying files.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fixes coding standard violations in place.
scripts-descriptions.infection: Runs mutation testing and enforces the configured minimum mutation score.
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit test suite against Testbench.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Runs the test suite and generates a coverage report.
